title: Latin Pop
tagline: Pop songwriting connected to the many languages and rhythms of Latin music.
summary: Latin pop brings popular songwriting together with musical traditions and contemporary sounds from Latin America, Spain, and their diasporas. Songs may incorporate rock, dance, regional rhythms, and urban production, often moving between Spanish, Portuguese, and English. The label covers a broad, changing musical landscape.

pillars.name: Gloria Estefan
pillars.why: Estefan brought Cuban-American musical influences into international pop through a long-running recording career.

pillars.name: Ricky Martin
pillars.why: Martin helped bring Spanish-language pop into global mainstream charts with dance-oriented recordings.

pillars.name: Shakira
pillars.why: Shakira built an international career by moving between Latin pop, rock, and dance production.
